justification: GA: 'Use common and proper nouns' = CCSS L.1.1b (GA omits 'possessive'; closest available leaf).
GA: 'Use singular and plural subjects with matching verbs' = CCSS L.1.1c verbatim.
GA: 'Use personal pronouns (subject, object, possessive)' = CCSS L.1.1d's personal/possessive pronoun coverage.
GA: 'Form and use verbs by adding -ing, -ed, or -s' = CCSS L.1.1e's regular verb tense forms.
GA: 'Form and use the simple verb tenses' = CCSS L.1.1e's general tense target.
GA: 'Form and use the past tense of irregular verbs' = CCSS L.1.1e's irregular-verb tense coverage.
GA: 'Capitalize proper nouns' = CCSS L.1.2a (GA generalizes 'dates/names' to 'proper nouns').
GA: 'Use context...to determine or clarify the meaning of unknown...words' = CCSS L.1.4a verbatim.
GA: 'Acquire and apply...vocabulary...through grade-level texts' = CCSS L.1.6's acquisition-through-reading target.
GA: 'Use grade-level...vocabulary...to communicate' = CCSS L.1.6's application/communication target.
GA: 'Use knowledge of word relationships...when making word choices' = CCSS L.1.6's relational-word-knowledge target.
GA: 'Describe traits of main characters...central message, lesson, or moral' = CCSS RL.1.2 verbatim.
GA: 'Identify techniques...characters, setting, major events, dialogue' = CCSS RL.1.3 verbatim.
GA: 'Identify and explain the use of descriptive words in texts' = CCSS RL.1.4 (feelings/sensory words).
GA: 'Use text features (e.g., illustrations...) to add clarity and meaning' -- the only GA standard mentioning illustrations; = CCSS RL.1.7 verbatim.
GA: 'Work with others to discuss topics...' = CCSS SL.1.1's collaborative-conversation target.
GA: 'Collaborate...to determine group norms, establish goals and procedures' = CCSS SL.1.1a's discussion-rules target.
GA: 'Engage in dialogue with audiences by asking and answering questions' = CCSS SL.1.2 verbatim.
GA (Writing domain): 'Generate ideas for content by assessing prior knowledge, gathering information from texts...' = CCSS W.1.8's own Writing-strand wording.
